heading: About
body: I'm Debasis Nishank, a developer and founder based in Bhubaneswar, India. I run Threemates, a software development studio building ERP systems, SaaS platforms, and web & mobile apps that help businesses digitize their operations and scale.
Alongside Threemates, I lead backend engineering at Rabinnson, building multi-tenant SaaS systems for regulatory compliance.

My core stack is Java and Spring — Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Hibernate, and REST — backed by PostgreSQL and MongoDB, with React and Next.js on the frontend. I containerise and ship with Docker, Git, and Maven.

I've built a range of systems: a multi-panel employee management platform (EvoStaff), an AWS-based facial-recognition attendance system, and Edu-SaaS, a configurable cloud ERP for educational institutions.

I hold a B.Tech in Computer Science from Centurion University of Technology and Management (CGPA 9.1, 2025), along with certifications in Java Full Stack Development from Wipro and digital governance from eGov Academy.
I'm always open to discussing backend and full-stack work, freelance projects, or new ideas. Reach me at nishankdebasis4@gmail.com.
